name: terylon-ado
description: The Azure DevOps adapter — fills the terylon-forge port with ADO mechanics over Microsoft's remote Azure DevOps MCP server (https://mcp.dev.azure.com), signed in with OAuth as the owner. The connect skill registers it from ADO_MCP_CLIENT_ID and ADO_MCP_TENANT_ID; every call carries ADO_ORGANIZATION. No default organisation.
